countingRule: one GET against <url>/api/spine/property-atoms/<parcel>/facets; verdict from the BODY (error/atomPathReason/message markers) then the status (401); a 200 with no marker is ok, anything else is a refusal
basis: HTTP 200 and a JSON object with no auth marker (readPath=record; readPath is NOT asserted, see bypass (3))
note: no header, no token and no secret value is read or printed; readPath is reported, not asserted (bypass 3)
